checks.label: A charged, rested cell reads 2.1 V, so six cells make an emf of 12.6 V, and with no current the voltmeter reads all of it
The same 100 Ah battery drained in two hours may give only 56 Ah: the rule gives 100 Ah at 5 A and 56 Ah at 28 A, and their dots land there
Lead acid is rated at 0.05C, a 20-hour discharge: 0.05 × 100 Ah is 5 A, and 5 A runs 20 hours
An ideal battery has a Peukert exponent of 1.00 and the same capacity at any current, while the monitor default of 1.25 would give 67 Ah at 25 A: the perfect line is flat at 100 Ah
A battery giving 100 percent at 27 °C delivers only 50 percent at −18 °C: 20 A gives 63 Ah warm and 31 Ah cold, 5 A runs 10 hours cold, and every dot falls by the same half
In very high currents the battery gives even less than a fixed exponent predicts: a dot past the highest rating lands hollow, with an arrow down, and dots up to it land solid on the line
Lost volts are I × r: 0.35 V at 50 A and 0.70 V at 100 A, so the terminals read 12.25 V and 11.90 V, and the load reads 0.245 Ω and 0.119 Ω
Through the two ratings n = log 10 ÷ log 5.6 = 1.34 and the line's gradient is 1 − n = −0.34: at 25 A it gives 2.3 hours and 58 Ah where 100 ÷ 25 says 4, at 20 A 63 Ah and at 100 A 36 Ah
The faster the draw, the lower the dot and the bigger the lost volts: capacity falls and lost volts rise at every step up in current
Halving the 0.245 Ω load nearly doubles the current, to 97 A, and the terminals dip to 11.92 V; cold doubles r to 14 mΩ, and the lost volts at 20 A from 0.14 V to 0.28 V
Each puzzle accepts only its right answer, and nothing in its picture gives the answer before Check
A test ends at an end voltage, 1.75 V a cell for a 5 to 8 hour run, 10.50 V for six: each run starts I × r below the emf and slides to it, so a faster run starts closer to the end
A ship's emergency battery holds within 12% of its nominal voltage: for 24 V the band is 21.1 V to 26.9 V, and the terminals under load sit below the emf and above the floor
Every demonstration settles within 4.6 s of its screen opening and ends where its screen says, and every answer's motion settles within 2.5 s
